1. Petitioners, through the medium of this petition seek quashment of FIR No. 02 of 2024 dated 02.01.2024 under Sections 458, 376-D of IPC registered with the SHO Police Station Budhal,
District Rajouri.

2. Issue notice to respondents, returnable within four weeks.
3. Requisite steps for service be taken within a week's time.
4. List again on 11.03.2025.
